name: Coffee 'N' Talk Coffee Roasters
notes: No official restaurant website; work list address (1143 6th Ave, San Diego, CA 92101) matched exactly against this DoorDash store's schema.org address ("1143 Sixth Avenue", San Diego) before extracting. Prices read from server-rendered JSON-LD Menu schema in the raw DoorDash HTML (tier 3, white-label marketplace). Excluded the 'Most Ordered' section as a duplicate cross-listing of items already counted under their real sections (Cold Drinks, Bagels, etc.) - deduped by name, keeping first occurrence. Markup-divisor test (1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30) showed no clean uniform divisor once the sample's heavy clustering at a flat $6.00 price (19 of 61 items) is accounted for - that clustering is what produced surface hits at 1.2, not markup. A WebSearch summary for this restaurant reported sandwich prices (Turkey Brie $13.00, Chicken Pesto $13.00, Classic BLT $11.00, Veggie $13.00) that do NOT match the raw JSON-LD (Turkey Brie $15.50, Chicken Pesto $17.00, Classic BLT $14.00, Veggie Sandwich $15.00) - the summary was discarded entirely per the 'summarizer will invent prices' rule; only the raw bytes were used. Uber Eats listing for the same address returned a near-empty bot-blocked page (556 bytes) and could not be used to cross-check. Sections covered: Sandwiches, Cold Drinks, Bagels, Omelette, More Food, Hot Drinks, Signature Coffee Drinks, Acai Bowls - appears to be the full DoorDash-listed catalog for this location.
